description: A commercial web service that interprets existing consumer raw genotype files for educational peptide-related research reports. It applies deterministic scoring to a published 144-marker panel, reports eight pharmacogenes and scores 39 peptides. Input coverage and evidence tiers are reported separately. The peptide scoring is exploratory and is not a clinically validated predictor of treatment response. It is not a laboratory testing or prescribing service.
name: PeptidesDNA
